name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: I'm applying for the Account Executive, Commercial role. I should be direct about two things upfront: I don't have construction industry experience, and the deals I've closed have run in the tens of thousands rather than the larger quotas this role references. What I do have is a real, repeated track record of running full B2B SaaS sales cycles and beating quota against a team of peers.

At Accelo, I ranked top three in sales on a team of 8 to 15 reps for effectively my entire tenure, while quota roughly doubled over that period, selling and scoping complex CRM and project-management software to agencies and professional-services firms, the same kind of technical, workflow-heavy product a commercial contractor would need walked through, not just pitched. I built relationships with C-suite executives as a trusted advisor on operational system design, which is the muscle this role needs for multi-threaded sales cycles with skeptical, non-technical buyers. At Fetch & Funnel, I closed six new-logo deals in a short tenure, roughly $130K in bookings, proof I can hunt, not just manage an existing book.

I'm comfortable demoing a technical product, forecasting accurately, and working a territory end to end. I'd welcome the chance to talk through how that track record applies to new-logo acquisition in the construction and trades space.
